title: lavatera triloba f. minoricensis
intro: Lavatera triloba f. minoricensis, commonly known as Minorican Lavatera, is a variety of the Lavatera triloba plant, a species of flowering plant in the hibiscus family (Malvaceae). This plant is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Minorican Lavatera include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in wound healing, reducing fever, and protecting against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
